task.title: Add a photo to a person
task.shortdesc: Choose a photo or a scan from your PC for a person's page.

prereq.p: Open the page of the person. says how.

step.cmd: Find the part of the page named .

stepresult.p: It has three buttons with a small picture on each. says what each one is for.

step.cmd: Choose the button with a folder on it.

stepresult.p: Windows opens its own window for choosing a file.

step.cmd: Choose the photo or the scan, then choose .

result.p: You have chosen a photo or a scan for the person. Look at the part named on the page.
The button with a camera on it is the button for taking a photo. says where keeps your pictures.
